entities.name: N,N-Dimethylethane-1,2-diamine
observations: Decoded structure: CN(C)CCN; the terminal primary amine is the likely SNAr nucleophile.

entities.name: 2-Chloro-6-DMAM-pyridine
observations: Decoded structure: CN(C)Cc1cccc(Cl)n1; the 2-chloro substituent is displaced in the proposed transformation.

entities.name: Chloropyridine SNAr with diamine
observations: Base-promoted nucleophilic aromatic substitution replaces chloride on the activated chloropyridine with the terminal primary amine of N,N-dimethylethane-1,2-diamine.
Sodium hydroxide and pyridine are interpreted as base/solvent or acid-scavenging components.
An ORD precedent supports substitution at the same chloropyridine core, but with cysteamine rather than the supplied diamine.
